div.span:
From a proposed chantier to a deployed change, with the owner involved only where it matters.
Scope: one chantier. Out of scope: the inner loop of each PR (make check, hooks).
Agents merge only PRs of a chantier the owner approved on the review stack.
v0.1 · source: docs/architecture/system
